functions.name: KATEX
functions.description: Renders a LaTeX mathematical equation locally via KaTeX into an in-cell image or floating shape.

parameters.name: latexString
parameters.description: The LaTeX mathematical formula string to render (e.g. '\frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}').

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Background color code or CSS string: 0 or 'transparent' (default), 1 or 'white' (#ffffff), 2 or 'black' (#000000), or custom hex/CSS color.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Foreground equation color (e.g. '#000000', '#ffffff', 'red'). Defaults to black on light/transparent bg, and white on black bg.

parameters.name: displayMode
parameters.description: Whether to render in display math mode (true) or inline mode (false). Default: true.

parameters.name: outputMethod
parameters.description: Output method: 'auto' (in-cell image if supported, shape fallback), 'cell' (force in-cell image), or 'shape' (force floating shape). Default: 'auto'.
